verdict.rationale: Cognee accepts natural-language queries: recall() classifies a free-text query and picks the retrieval strategy itself, the CLI lets users ask questions, and a Linear agent answers @mentions from memory. Its official MCP server also exposes Cognee to AI assistants, so memory can be driven conversationally, though the assistant does the language interpretation. Natural-language operation is documented mainly for querying, not for running the product as a whole. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of non-query operations (remember/improve/forget/dataset management) within Cognee itself, examples of conversational operation through MCP tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
